FC-AMEND-CANNOT-CLEAR — CLOSED 2026-08-11, and closing it RAISED the score. The cell was 331x88 because its ROOT carried a bound 12/16 padding + gap 8 that its committed spec DOES NOT DECLARE: the header part's padding applied twice (header 299x64 -> root 331x88). Cause: the emitted runtime's applyFrameSpec only ever SET what the spec declares, so on the AMEND path a spacing fact the contract had dropped survived forever, while a fresh createComponent started at 0 — the two paths silently disagreed, and specHash matching reported "skipped: unchanged" over it. The runtime now resets undeclared paddingTop/Right/Bottom/Left/itemSpacing before applying the declared ones (RUNTIME_EMIT_REV rt13-amend-clears-undeclared-spacing). Rebuilt from the committed script: 299x64, root padding 0. THE HEIGHT NOW MATCHES THE REFERENCE (64) AND THE CONTRACT RENDER (64) EXACTLY, where it was 24px over. Census across all 77 scored cells on both connected files: this was the ONLY root carrying padding its spec does not declare, so the reset changed exactly one scored cell.

FC-REF-STAGE-WIDTH — what the residual IS, now that the height error is gone. The pair is 299x64 vs 320x64: heights identical, no DPR halve and no size-normalize, and the whole gap is width. 320 is astryx's stage content box for this stem (352 file - 2x16 padding) and Banner is blockStage:true, so a block element FILLS it — 320 is a fact about the harness, not about Banner. The canvas hugs at 299 and the contract render hugs at 284. The scorer rescales 299->320 (1.07x) and throws every glyph out of register. Same cause as mui/alert. It cannot be closed by widening the canvas: that mints the capture WINDOW as a component fact, the regression class Option B settled.

A WRONG CANVAS SCORED BETTER THAN A RIGHT ONE, which is the finding worth keeping. At 331x88 the scorer dpr-halved and size-normalized the pair into 160x32 and read 8.60; at the correct 299x64 it reads 14.94. Nothing about the canvas got worse — a 24px height error was removed. Read this as a caution about size-normalized AA numbers, not as a regression.

FC-REF-TONE-SWAP: 96.4% colour-histogram distance between the canvas cell and the library Status=Info banner while the AA number reads 8.60. The canvas paints the pastel core-plane fill; the library paints the neutral-plane header. Named so the AA number is not read as closeness.

FC-THEME-BASE: the capture mount renders under `<Theme theme={neutralTheme}>` (@astryxdesign/theme-neutral — the library’s documented Quick Start and the only mount where the base font resolves), while examples/astryx/tokens/astryx.dtcg.json is wrapped from @astryxdesign/core/src/theme/tokens.stylex.ts, the CORE DEFAULT palette. Measured: core --color-accent #0064E0 vs theme-neutral #262626; core --color-text-primary #0A1317 vs #171717; core --color-background-blue #0171E333 vs #c4ddfb. The canvas paints the core plane, the library renders the neutral plane, and no re-promote closes it: promoting from the neutral captures strands 30 of the 36 acked re-anchoring rows (65 leaves) with no alias target, dropping the astryx bundle from 54 Figma-native aliases to 13 and failing the plugin-engine-check pin. A HUMAN decision on which plane is astryx’s canonical repo-side theme is required; nothing was force-fitted.
